scope: Candidate selection and R2B bench plan; no purchase, firmware flash, physical wiring or calibration has been validated.

required_before_integration: Read AUTOPILOT_VERSION, board identity and startup log from the actual controller; archive firmware hash, build type and complete parameter snapshot.
Verify ExternalNav, optical-flow message handling, port mapping and forwarding options against that exact firmware.
Re-run AP command freshness, coordinate conversion, source handover and loss-of-input checks for the chosen firmware without replacing the frozen 4.5.7 evidence.
flight_controller.version_note: CUAV guides contain different backport versions; the observed upstream stable version is not a measurement of the user's board.

recommended_flow_candidate.interface: 3.3 V LVTTL UART, 115200 baud; 5 V sensor supply
recommended_flow_candidate.vendor_range_conditions: Chinese manual: up to 12 m at 90% reflectance / 600 lux, 8 m at 90% reflectance / 70 klux; not an optical-flow usable-height guarantee.
recommended_flow_candidate.protocol_candidate_for_orin_research: Explicitly configured Micolink; raw serial capture retained
recommended_flow_candidate.protocol_candidate_for_ap_baseline: Explicitly configured Mavlink_apm; actual on-wire messages verified

native_measurement_contract.sensor_time: uint32 time_ms described as system milliseconds; exposure/integration reference is unverified
native_measurement_contract.range: distance in mm; zero means unavailable; status and strength retained
native_measurement_contract.flow: flow_vel_x/y in cm/s@1m; vendor formula speed_cm_s = flow_value * height_m
native_measurement_contract.conversion_condition: The vendor formula does not establish a general body-velocity model on tilted or nonplanar terrain. Validate axes, surface geometry, range footprint, lever arm and rotation handling first.
native_measurement_contract.rotation_compensation: Unknown for the actual module firmware; do not assume an onboard gyro or compensate rotation twice.
native_measurement_contract.quality: Vendor quality/status are retained diagnostics, not a calibrated covariance or integrity probability.

alternative.range_conditions: Chinese and English vendor pages disagree on outdoor range conditions; confirm the delivered revision with the vendor before freezing the envelope.

specification_conflicts: MTF-01P near-range accuracy differs between Chinese and English pages (4 cm versus 2 cm); no accuracy advantage is claimed from those figures.

recommended_camera_candidate.variant_requirement: Non-L version with external trigger / I/O
recommended_camera_candidate.driver_support: Vendor lists Linux ARMv8 / Galaxy Linux ARM SDK V2.4.2507, but its recommended platforms list older Ubuntu/Jetson releases. Actual Orin NX carrier, JetPack, Galaxy SDK and ROS 2 combination requires vendor confirmation and bench validation.
recommended_camera_candidate.image_encoding: Mono output requires an explicit, tested adapter for the chosen visual frontend; it is not assumed to be a drop-in replacement for the author's color camera.
recommended_camera_candidate.lens: C/CS mount fixed-focus lens; exact focal length and image circle to be selected after overlap, distortion and indoor exposure tests
recommended_camera_candidate.exposure_policy: Calibrate with locked exposure/gain; evaluate bounded auto exposure as a separate experiment and log per-frame settings.
recommended_camera_candidate.synchronization: External trigger is a capability, not an established camera/LiDAR common clock; trigger circuit, levels, timing and timestamp mapping remain to be designed and measured.

reproduction_alternative.basis: FAST-LIVO2-associated LIV_handhold BOM includes this model and provides synchronization/ROS 1 wrapper sources with ARM support. Current supply and a valid manufacturer datasheet have not been established here; the ROS 2 integration remains work.

primary_research_path: Mid-360 Ethernet and industrial camera USB3 to Orin NX
MTF-01P UART Micolink to Orin NX through an electrically compatible verified adapter
Orin common-state estimator to CUAV X25 MEGA via MAVLink ExternalNav; ArduPilot retains flight control
integration_plan.ap_direct_flow_baseline: Separate configuration: MTF-01P Mavlink_apm directly to the flight controller; archive the actual firmware and EKF source configuration.
integration_plan.double_counting_constraint: If ExternalNav already incorporates this flow/range, AP must not treat the same measurements as an additional independent source without an explicit correlation treatment.
integration_plan.fallback_scope: A sensor connected only through Orin cannot provide an Orin-independent fallback. AP-direct fallback needs a separately validated physical path and source-switching experiment.
integration_plan.dependency_policy: Track shared IMU, map, time, calibration and ToF scale; separate physical modules are not proof of statistical independence. Shared range can correlate both flow velocity axes.

r2b_validation_sequence.experiment: Bench capture without propellers; archive device/firmware/SDK/JetPack identities, serial bytes, frame counters, acquisition and receipt timestamps, exposure/gain and range/flow status.
r2b_validation_sequence.gate: Every field has verified units, axes and time semantics; unknown fields stay unavailable rather than receiving simulated defaults.

r2b_validation_sequence.experiment: Measure clock drift/reset/wrap and pipeline latency; calibrate camera intrinsics, sensor extrinsics and trigger timing. Use controlled translation and pure rotation with external reference to identify flow scale and compensation.
r2b_validation_sequence.gate: Use separate calibration and held-out runs; freeze measured uncertainty and validity limits before fusion comparison.

r2b_validation_sequence.experiment: Vary height, floor texture/reflectance, light, tilt and motion independently, then combine failures; retain invalid measurements and dropout durations.
r2b_validation_sequence.gate: Determine usable optical-flow/ToF envelope and quality-to-error relationship from held-out data; advertised range is not an acceptance threshold.

r2b_validation_sequence.experiment: Compare LiDAR-IMU, LiDAR-camera-IMU and added flow/ToF; ablate shared-scale/time error handling. Evaluate AP-direct flow separately, then test source handover and Orin loss.
r2b_validation_sequence.gate: Report task-level accuracy, interval coverage, alert delay, availability and loss-of-input behavior with independent reference; no hardware PASS from R2A simulation.

frozen_evidence_boundary: config/research_multisensor_contract.json remains the R2A simulation profile. This plan is not loaded by launch files and does not validate any hardware stream.
